original: kiṃ ca “tribhiḥ ṛṇaiḥ ṛṇavā jāyate yajñena devebhyaḥ prajayā pitṛbhyaḥ svādhyāyena ṛṣibhyaḥ” ity etacchrutiḥ mūlaṃ tv asya saṃbhavati mūlāntarakalpanāyā anyāyyatvam | tathā ca “putrārthī saṃviśed” ity anenaitacchrutimūlatvam asyācārya āviṣkariṣyati | evaṃ caitanmūlatvād apy asya niyamatvam avasīyate | jātaputrasya tv aniyamaḥ, ekaputrotpādane vidheś caritārthatvāt | tathā ca “kāmajāṃs tu” iti darśanāt | “naikaputraṃ dadyāt pratigṛhṇīyād vā sa hi santānāya pūrveṣām” iti ca | yat tu “daśāsyāṃ putrān ādhehi” iti bahvapatyapraśaṃsāparam, jātaputrasyāpi ṛtukāle niyamagamane kathaṃ daśatve vāvatiṣṭhet | evaṃ ca niyamo ‘yaṃ na tv anṛtukāle gamananiṣedhārthā parisaṃkhyeti |

original: yathā cāha maṅgalācārayuktānām iti | maṅgalādyanuṣṭhānaśīlānāṃ śuddhānāṃ japahomaparāyaṇānāṃ daivapuruṣakṛta upadravo na vidyate || 4.146 ||
analyzed: yathā ca āha maṅgala ācāra yuktānām iti maṅgala ādi anuṣṭhāna śīlānām śuddhānām japa homa parāyaṇānām daiva puruṣa kṛtaḥ upadravaḥ na vidyate

original: vedam eva japen nityaṃ yathākālam atandritaḥ |
analyzed: vedam eva japet nityam yathākālam atandritaḥ

original: taṃ hy asyāhuḥ paraṃ dharmam upadharmo ‘nya ucyate || 4.147 ||
analyzed: tam hi asya āhuḥ param dharmam upadharmaḥ nyaḥ ucyate

original: vedam eva japen nityam iti | yasmin yasmin kāle dṛṣṭārthakarmoparodho bhavati tatra nityaṃ vedam evānalasaḥ san japaet | yasmāt taṃ brahmaṇasya paraṃ dharmaṃ manvādaya āhuḥ | tadanyas tv amukhyo dharmas tair ucyate || 4.147 ||
analyzed: vedam eva japet nityam iti yasmin yasmin kāle dṛṣṭa artha karma uparodhaḥ bhavati tatra nityam vedam eva analasaḥ san japaet yasmāt tam param dharmam manu ādayaḥ āhuḥ tad anyaḥ tu amukhyaḥ dharmaḥ taiḥ ucyate

original: vedābhyāsena satataṃ śaucena tapasaiva ca |
analyzed: veda abhyāsena satatam śaucena tapasā eva ca

original: adroheṇa ca bhūtānāṃ jātiṃ smarati paurvikīm || 4.148 ||
analyzed: adroheṇa ca bhūtānām jātim smarati paurvikīm

original: uktasyāpi vedābhyāsasya yad arthaṃ punar abhidhānaṃ tad āha vedābhyāseneti | nityaṃ vedābhyāsaśaucatapo’hiṃsābhiḥ pūrvabhavasya janma smarati || 4.148 ||
analyzed: uktasya api veda abhyāsasya yat artham punar abhidhānam tat āha veda abhyāsena iti nityam veda abhyāsa śauca tapaḥ hiṃsābhiḥ pūrva bhavasya janma smarati

original: paurvikīṃ saṃsmaran jātiṃ brahmaivābhyasyate dvijaḥ |
analyzed: paurvikīm saṃsmaran jātim brahma eva abhyasyate dvijaḥ

original: brahmābhyāsena cājasram anantaṃ sukham aśnute || 4.149 ||
analyzed: brahma abhyāsena ca ajasram anantam sukham aśnute

original: tataḥ kim ata āha paurvikīm iti | pūrvajātiṃ svāṃ saṃsmaran īdṛg ayaṃ vedābhyāsaḥ yena janmāntaraṃ smaryata iti matvā abhīkṣṇaṃ vedābhyāsam eva karoti tena cānavaratam ācaryamāṇe vedārthāvabodhajāte sati brahmaprāptau paramātmarūpam akṣayaṃ sukhaṃ prāpnoti || 4.149 ||
analyzed: tatas kim atas āha paurvikīm iti pūrva jātim svām saṃsmaran īdṛś ayam veda abhyāsaḥ yena janmāntaram smaryate iti matvā abhīkṣṇam veda abhyāsam eva karoti tena ca anavaratam ācaryamāṇe veda artha avabodha jāte sati brahma prāptau paramātma rūpam akṣayam sukham prāpnoti

original: sāvitrān śāntihomāṃś ca kuryāt parvasu nityaśaḥ |
analyzed: sāvitrān śānti homān ca kuryāt parvasu nityaśas

original: pitṝṃś caivāṣṭakāsv arcen nityam anvaṣṭakāsu ca || 4.150 ||
analyzed: pitṝn ca eva aṣṭakāsu arcet nityam anvaṣṭakāsu ca

original: sāvitrān iti | savitṛdevatākān aniṣṭanivṛttyarthāṃś ca homān pakṣasaṃdhiṣu amāvāsyādiṣu ca “ājyaṃ havir anādeyam” iti sūtrakārasmaraṇāt ājyena nityaṃ kuryāt | tathā aṣṭakākhyena karmaṇā aṣṭakāpaścādbhāvinīṣu ca navamīṣu anvaṣṭakākhyena karmaṇā pramītān pitrādīn tarpayet || 4.150 ||
analyzed: sāvitrān iti savitṛ devatākān aniṣṭa nivṛtti arthān ca homān pakṣa saṃdhiṣu amāvāsyā ādiṣu ca ājyam haviḥ anādeyam iti sūtrakāra smaraṇāt ājyena nityam kuryāt tathā aṣṭakā ākhyena karmaṇā aṣṭakā paścāt bhāvinīṣu ca navamīṣu anvaṣṭakā ākhyena karmaṇā pramītān pitṛ ādīn tarpayet

original: dūrād āvasathān mūtraṃ dūrāt pādāvasecanam |
analyzed: dūrāt āvasathāt mūtram dūrāt pāda avasecanam

original: ucchiṣṭānnaniṣekaṃ ca dūrād eva samācaret || 4.151 ||
analyzed: ucchiṣṭa anna niṣekam ca dūrāt eva samācaret

original: dūrād iti | “kṣipraṃ gatvā kṣepamātraṃ śarasya” iti purāṇasmaraṇad evaṃvidhāt gṛhasya dūrāt mūtrapurīṣapādadhāvanodakocchiṣṭapariṣekodakādy utsṛjet || 4.151 ||
analyzed: dūrāt iti kṣipram gatvā kṣepa mātram śarasya iti evaṃvidhāt gṛhasya dūrāt mūtra purīṣa pāda dhāvana udaka ucchiṣṭa pariṣeka udaka ādi utsṛjet

original: maitraṃ prasādhanaṃ snānaṃ dantadhāvanam añjanam |
analyzed: maitram prasādhanam snānam danta dhāvanam añjanam

original: pūrvāhṇa eva kurvīta devatānāṃ ca pūjanam || 4.152 ||
analyzed: pūrvāhṇe eva kurvīta devatānām ca pūjanam

original: maitram iti | maitraṃ pāyur iti paśvaṅgasaṃstave pāyau mitradevatākathanaśravaṇād ihāpy abhedopacāreṇa maitraḥ pāyuḥ | tatra bhavaḥ utsarge sati śaucaṃ tathānulepanādiśarīrasaṃskāranityasnānadantadhāvanāñjanadevārcanāni pūrvāhṇa eva kurvīta || 4.152 ||
analyzed: maitram iti maitram pāyuḥ iti paśu aṅga saṃstave pāyau mitra devatā kathana śravaṇāt iha api abheda upacāreṇa maitraḥ pāyuḥ tatra bhavaḥ utsarge sati śaucam tathā anulepana ādi śarīra saṃskāra nitya snāna danta dhāvana añjana deva arcanāni pūrvāhṇe eva kurvīta

original: daivatāny abhigacchet tu dhārmikāṃś ca dvijottamān |
analyzed: daivatāni abhigacchet tu dhārmikān ca dvijottamān

original: īśvaraṃ caiva rakṣārthaṃ gurūn eva ca parvasu || 4.153 ||
analyzed: īśvaram ca eva rakṣā artham gurūn eva ca parvasu

original: daivatāny abhigacched iti | daivatāni suvarṇamaṇyādikṛtāni dharmapradhānāṃś ca brāhmaṇān pālanasamarthaṃ ca rājādikaṃ rakṣārthaṃ gurūṃś cāpi pitrādīn amāvāsyādiṣu pakṣasaṃdhiṣu ca draṣṭuṃ gacchet || 4.153 ||
analyzed: daivatāni abhigacchet iti daivatāni suvarṇa maṇi ādi kṛtāni dharma pradhānān ca brāhmaṇān pālana samartham ca rāja ādikam rakṣā artham gurūn ca api pitṛ ādīn amāvāsyā ādiṣu pakṣa saṃdhiṣu ca draṣṭum gacchet

original: abhivādayed vṛddhāṃś ca dadyāc caivāsanaṃ svakam |
analyzed: abhivādayet vṛddhān ca dadyāt ca eva āsanam svakam

original: kṛtāñjalir upādīta gacchataḥ pṛṣṭhato ‘nviyāt || 4.154 ||
analyzed: kṛtāñjaliḥ upādīta gacchataḥ pṛṣṭhatas nu iyāt

original: abhivādayed iti | gṛhāgatān (gatā) jyāyaso (jyāyāṃso) ‘bhivādayet teṣāṃ cātmīyam āsanam upaveśanārthaṃ dadyāt | baddhāñjaliṃś ca tatsamīpam āsīta | gacchataścb ca paścād anuvrajet | uktam apīdam abhivādanādi vakṣyamāṇaphalābhidhitsayā punar ucyate || 4.154 ||
analyzed: abhivādayet iti gṛha āgatān gatāḥ jyāyasaḥ jyāyāṃsaḥ bhivādayet teṣām ca ātmīyam āsanam upaveśana artham dadyāt baddhāñjalin ca tad samīpam āsīta gacchataḥ ca paścāt anuvrajet uktam api idam abhivādana ādi vakṣyamāṇa phala abhidhitsayā punar ucyate

original: śrutismṛtyuditaṃ samyaṅ nibaddhaṃ sveṣu karmasu |
analyzed: śruti smṛti uditam samyak nibaddham sveṣu karmasu

original: dharmamūlaṃ niṣeveta sadācāram atandritaḥ || 4.155 ||
analyzed: dharma mūlam niṣeveta sat ācāram atandritaḥ

original: śrutismṛtyuditam iti | śrutismṛtibhyāṃ samyag uktaṃ sveṣu cādhyayanayāgādiṣv aṅgatvena saṃbaddhaṃ dharmasya mūlabhūtaṃ sādhvācāram analasaḥ san abhīkṣṇam anutiṣṭhet
analyzed: śruti smṛti uditam iti śruti smṛtibhyām samyak uktam sveṣu ca adhyayana yāga ādiṣu aṅga tvena saṃbaddham dharmasya mūla bhūtam sādhu ācāram analasaḥ san abhīkṣṇam anutiṣṭhet

original: ācārāl labhate hy āyur ācārād īpsitāḥ prajāḥ |
analyzed: ācārāt labhate hi āyuḥ ācārāt īpsitāḥ prajāḥ

original: ācārād dhanam akṣayyam ācāro hanty alakṣaṇam || 4.156 ||
analyzed: ācārāt dhanam akṣayyam ācāraḥ hanti alakṣaṇam

original: yad artham ācārasya punar vacanaṃ tad āha ācārād iti | āyuriṣṭāpatyākṣayadhanāny ācārāt tadanuṣṭhānāl labhate | duṣṭalakṣaṇaṃ ca priyabhāryāvināśasaṃsūcakaṃ tilakādyācāro niṣphalīkarotīty ācāraphalakathanam | na cānityatāāpattiḥ, “sāvitrīmātrasāro ‘pi” (2.118) ityādinā nityatvasya samarpitatvāt || 4.156 ||
analyzed: yat artham ācārasya punar vacanam tat āha ācārāt iti āyuḥ iṣṭa apatya akṣaya dhanāni ācārāt tad anuṣṭhānāt labhate duṣṭa lakṣaṇam ca priya bhāryā vināśa saṃsūcakam tilaka ādi ācāraḥ niṣphalīkaroti iti ācāra phala kathanam na ca anitya tā āpattiḥ ityādinā nitya tvasya samarpita tvāt

original: durācāro hi puruṣo loke bhavati ninditaḥ |
analyzed: durācāraḥ hi puruṣaḥ loke bhavati ninditaḥ

original: duḥkhabhāgī ca satataṃ vyādhito ‘lpāyur eva ca || 4.157 ||
analyzed: duḥkha bhāgī ca satatam vyādhitaḥ lpa āyuḥ eva ca

original: durācāra iti | yasmād durācāraḥ puruṣo loke ca garhitaḥ sarvadā ca duḥkhito vyādhito ‘lpāyur bhavati, tasmāt svācāreṇa bhāvyam || 4.157 ||
analyzed: durācāraḥ iti yasmāt durācāraḥ puruṣaḥ loke ca garhitaḥ sarvadā ca duḥkhitaḥ vyādhitaḥ lpa āyuḥ bhavati tasmāt su ācāreṇa bhāvyam

original: sarvalakṣaṇahīno ‘pi yaḥ sadācāravān naraḥ |
analyzed: sarva lakṣaṇa hīnaḥ u pi yaḥ sat ācāravān naraḥ

original: śraddadhāno ‘nasūyaś ca śataṃ varṣāṇi jīvati || 4.158 ||
analyzed: śraddadhānaḥ nasūyaḥ ca śatam varṣāṇi jīvati

original: sarvalakṣaṇahīna iti | yaḥ samyag ācāravān śraddadhāno ‘kutsakaḥ sa ājānubāhutvādisarva-praśastalakṣaṇaśūnyo ‘pi varṣaśataṃ jīvati | prathame ‘dhyāye śāstrastutyarthā ācārastutiḥ | iha tv ācāraphalasamarpaṇārtham etat || 4.158 ||
analyzed: sarva lakṣaṇa hīnaḥ iti yaḥ samyak ācāravān śraddadhānaḥ kutsakaḥ saḥ ājānu bāhu tva ādi sarva praśasta lakṣaṇa śūnyaḥ varṣa śatam jīvati prathame dhyāye śāstra stuti arthā ācāra stutiḥ iha tu ācāra phala samarpaṇa artham etat

original: yad yat paravaśaṃ karma tat tad yatnena varjayet |
analyzed: yat yat para vaśam karma tat tat yatnena varjayet

original: yad yad ātmavaśaṃ tu syāt tat tat seveta yatnataḥ || 4.159 ||
analyzed: yat yat ātma vaśam tu syāt tat tat seveta yatnataḥ

original: yad yat paravaśam iti | yad yat parāyattam ayācitalābhādinā viśeṣadānādi karma tat tad yatnato varjayet | yad yat punar ātmādhīnaṃ svadhanaleśenāpi kenacit svalābhaparopakārādinā tat tat yatnena abhyaset || 4.159 ||
analyzed: yat yat paravaśam iti yat yat para āyattam a yācita lābha ādinā viśeṣa dāna ādi karma tat tat yatnataḥ varjayet yat yat punar ātma adhīnam sva dhana leśena api kenacid sva lābha para upakāra ādinā tat tat yatnena abhyaset

original: sarvaṃ paravaśaṃ duḥkhaṃ sarvam ātmavaśaṃ sukham |
analyzed: sarvam para vaśam duḥkham sarvam ātma vaśam sukham

original: etad vidyāt samāsena lakṣaṇaṃ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ || 4.160 ||
analyzed: etat vidyāt samāsena lakṣaṇam sukha duḥkhayoḥ

original: yasmāt sarvam iti | yat paraprārthanādisaṃsādhyaṃ tat sarvaṃ duḥkhahetu | yac cātmaikasādhanaṃ tat sarvaṃ sukhanimittam ity etat saṃkṣepataḥ sukhaduḥkhalakṣaṇaṃ jānīyāt || 4.160 ||
analyzed: yasmāt sarvam iti yat para prārthanā ādi saṃsādhyam tat sarvam duḥkha hetu yat ca ātma eka sādhanam tat sarvam sukha nimittam iti etat saṃkṣepataḥ sukha duḥkha lakṣaṇam jānīyāt

original: yat karma kurvato ‘sya syāt paritoṣo ‘ntarātmanaḥ |
analyzed: yat karma kurvataḥ sya syāt paritoṣaḥ ntarātmanaḥ

original: tat prayatnena kurvīta viparītaṃ tu varjayet || 4.161 ||
analyzed: tat prayatnena kurvīta viparītam tu varjayet

original: aśiṣṭāpratiṣiddhaṃ vaikalpikaṃ vā | yat karmeti | yat karma anutiṣṭhataḥ puṃso ‘ntarāmanaḥ paritoṣo bhavati tat yatnataḥ kurvīta | ātmatuṣṭikaraṃ punar varjayet || 4.161 ||
analyzed: a śiṣṭa a pratiṣiddham vaikalpikam vā yat karma iti yat karma anutiṣṭhataḥ puṃsaḥ ntarā āmanaḥ paritoṣaḥ bhavati tat yatnataḥ kurvīta ātma tuṣṭi karam punar varjayet

original: ācāryaṃ ca pravaktāraṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ gurum |
analyzed: ācāryam ca pravaktāram pitaram mātaram gurum

original: na hiṃsyād brāhmaṇān gāś ca sarvāṃś caiva tapasvinaḥ || 4.162 ||
analyzed: na hiṃsyāt brāhmaṇān gāḥ ca sarvān ca eva tapasvinaḥ

original: ācāryaṃ ceti | ācāryam adhyāpayitāraṃ copanayanamātrakāriṇaṃ lokavat pitaraṃ mātaraṃ gurum “alpaṃ vā bahu vā yasya” (2.149) ity uktam gobrāhmaṇataponiṣṭhāṃś ca ātatāyino ‘pi na hiṃsyāt | anyathā sāmānyahiṃsāniṣedhe sati idaṃ pṛthagvacanam anarthakaṃ syāt || 4.162 ||
analyzed: ācāryam ca iti ācāryam adhyāpayitāram ca upanayana mātra kāriṇam loka vat pitaram mātaram gurum alpam vā bahu vā yasya iti uktam go brāhmaṇa tapaḥ niṣṭhān ca ātatāyinaḥ na hiṃsyāt anyathā sāmānya hiṃsā niṣedhe sati idam pṛthagvacanam anarthakam syāt

original: nāstikyaṃ vedanindāṃ ca devatānāṃ ca kutsanam |
analyzed: nāstikyam veda nindām ca devatānām ca kutsanam

original: dveṣaṃ stambhaṃ ca mānaṃ ca krodhaṃ taikṣṇyaṃ ca varjayet || 4.163 ||
analyzed: dveṣam stambham ca mānam ca krodham taikṣṇyam ca varjayet

original: nāstikyam iti | dveṣaṃ stambhaṃ ca mānaṃ ca krodhaṃ taikṣṇyaṃ ca varjayet | nāsty adṛṣṭam ity eva buddhitvam, vedadevatāgarhaṇaṃ mātsaryānamratvādāv abhimānakrodhakrauryāṇi varjayet || 4.163 ||
analyzed: nāstikyam iti dveṣam stambham ca mānam ca krodham taikṣṇyam ca varjayet na asti adṛṣṭam iti eva buddhi tvam veda devatā garhaṇam mātsarya ānamra tva ādau abhimāna krodha krauryāṇi varjayet

original: parasya daṇḍaṃ nodyacchet kruddho nainaṃ nipātayet |
analyzed: parasya daṇḍam na udyacchet kruddhaḥ na enam nipātayet

original: anyatra putrāc chiṣyād vā. śiṣṭyarthaṃ tāḍayet tu tau || 4.164 ||
analyzed: anyatra putrāt śiṣyāt vā śiṣṭi artham tāḍayet tu tau

original: parasyeti | parasya daṇḍādi nodguryet kruddhaś ca san ātmanaḥ putraśiṣyabhāryākanīyānsodaryabhrātṛdāsān vakṣyamānān varjayitvā na prahāreṇa | tān punar anuśāsanārthaṃ “rajjvā veṇudalena vā” ityādiprakāreṇa tāḍayet || 4.164 ||
analyzed: parasya iti parasya daṇḍa ādi na udguryet kruddhaḥ ca san ātmanaḥ putra śiṣya bhāryā kanīyān sodarya bhrātṛ dāsān vakṣyamānān varjayitvā na prahāreṇa tān punar anuśāsana artham rajjvā veṇu dalena vā ityādi prakāreṇa tāḍayet

original: brāhmaṇāyāvaguryaiva dvijātir vadhakāmyayā |
analyzed: brāhmaṇāya avagurya eva dvijātiḥ vadha kāmyayā

original: śataṃ varṣāṇi tāmisre narake parivartate || 4.165 ||
analyzed: śatam varṣāṇi tāmisre narake parivartate

original: brāhmaṇāyeti | dvijātir api hananecchayā brāhmaṇasya daṇḍādyudyamyaiva varṣaśataṃ tāmisrākhye narake paribhrāmyati || 4.165 ||
analyzed: brāhmaṇāya iti dvijātiḥ api hanana icchayā brāhmaṇasya daṇḍa ādi udyamya eva varṣa śatam tāmisra ākhye narake paribhrāmyati

original: tāḍayitvā tṛṇenāpi saṃrambhān matipūrvakam |
analyzed: tāḍayitvā tṛṇena api saṃrambhāt mati pūrvakam

original: ekaviṃśatim ājātīḥ pāpayoniṣu jāyate || 4.166 ||
analyzed: ekaviṃśatim ājātīḥ pāpa yoniṣu jāyate

original: tāḍayitveti | krodhena buddhipūrvaṃ tṛṇenāpi prahṛtya ekaviṃśatijanmāni pāpanimittāsu śvādiyoniṣu jāyate | ājātīr ity āṅ pādapūraṇaḥ || 4.166 ||
analyzed: tāḍayitvā iti krodhena buddhi pūrvam tṛṇena api prahṛtya ekaviṃśati janmāni pāpa nimittāsu śva ādi yoniṣu jāyate ājātīḥ iti āṅ pāda pūraṇaḥ

original: ayudhyamānasyotpādya brāhmaṇasyāsṛg aṅgataḥ |
analyzed: a yudhyamānasya utpādya brāhmaṇasya asṛj aṅgataḥ

original: duḥkhaṃ sumahad āpnoti pretyāprājñatayā naraḥ || 4.167 ||
analyzed: duḥkham su mahat āpnoti pretya a prājña tayā naraḥ

original: ayudhyamānasyeti | yuddhaṃ vinā brāhmaṇaśarīrato maurkhyāt rudhiraṃ nara utpādya paraloke mahad duḥkhaṃ prāpnoti || 4.167 ||
analyzed: a yudhyamānasya iti yuddham vinā brāhmaṇa śarīrataḥ maurkhyāt rudhiram naraḥ utpādya para loke mahat duḥkham prāpnoti

original: śoṇitaṃ yāvataḥ pāṃśūn saṃgṛhṇāti mahītalāt |
analyzed: śoṇitam yāvataḥ pāṃśūn saṃgṛhṇāti mahī talāt

original: na sīdann iti | yathā dharmaśabdo yāgādau tajjanye cātmasaṃskāre dṛṣṭaprayogaḥ, evam adharmaśabdo ‘pi hiṃsādau tajjanye cātmasaṃskāre dṛṣṭapryogaḥ, ataḥ adhārmikāṇāṃ pāpānām iti evaṃ vyākhyāyate | hiṃsādyadharmacaraṇaśīlānāṃ tajjanyapāpākhyasaṃskārayuktānāṃ ihaloke rājopadravaṃ kṣipraṃ paśyan paraloke ca śāstradṛṣṭyā narakaṃ paśyan dharmānuṣṭhānenātmasaṃyamātiśaye sati avasādaṃ gacchann api manaḥ adharme na niyojayet || 4.171 ||

original: nādharma iti | yathā gauḥ vāhanadohanādinā sadyo loke phalati tathādharmaś caritaḥ sado na phalati | kiṃ tarhi | śanaiḥ śanaiḥ kālāntareṇa phaladānonmukhī bhavan kartur mūlānīva kṛntati | kṛttamūlāpādapavat kartāraṃ niaranvayaṃ nāśayati || 4.172 ||
analyzed: na adharmaḥ iti yathā gauḥ vāhana dohana ādinā sadyas loke phalati tathā adharmaḥ caritaḥ sadaḥ na phalati kim tarhi śanais śanais kāla antareṇa phala dāna unmukhī bhavan kartuḥ mūlāni iva kṛntati kṛtta mūlā pādapa vat kartāram nāśayati

original: yadīti | yadi svaśarīravyādhyutpādanadvāreṇādharmo na phalati tadā putrapautrarogādyudbhavamukhena phalati | na tv asau kṛtaḥ kadācit kartur niṣphalo bhavati yaiś ca duṣkṛtavaśena vyādhyādyupetair bhavitavyaṃ tathāvidhāḥ tasyātmaduṣkṛtabalāt tadvipattyādidarśanapīḍānubhavārthaṃ putrapautrā iha janmani janmāntare vā jāyante || 4.173 ||
analyzed: yadi iti yadi sva śarīra vyādhi utpādana dvāreṇa adharmaḥ na phalati tadā putra pautra roga ādi udbhava mukhena phalati na tu asau kṛtaḥ kadācid kartuḥ niṣphalaḥ bhavati yaiḥ ca duṣkṛta vaśena vyādhi ādi upetaiḥ bhavitavyam tathāvidhāḥ tasya ātma duṣkṛta balāt tad vipatti ādi darśana pīḍā anubhava artham putra pautrāḥ iha janmani janmāntare vā jāyante

original: adharmeṇaidhate tāvat tato bhadrāṇi paśyati |

original: adharmeneti | adharmeṇa parasvaharaṇādinā saṃprati dhanavṛddhyādiyukto bhavati | tadanantaraṃ taddhanādyupabhogadvāreṇa sukhāny anubhavati, tadanubhāvāc ca sukhitvādinā śatrūn abhibhavati, tato ‘sminn eva janmani sarvanāśaṃ naśyati mṛto vā apunarbhavaṃ narakam upaiti || 4.174 ||
analyzed: adharmena iti adharmeṇa para sva haraṇa ādinā saṃprati dhana vṛddhi ādi yuktaḥ bhavati tad anantaram tad dhana ādi upabhoga dvāreṇa sukhāni anubhavati tad anubhāvāt ca sukhitva ādinā śatrūn abhibhavati smin eva janmani sarva nāśam naśyati mṛtaḥ vā apunarbhavam narakam upaiti

original: yata evam ataḥ satyadharmāryavṛtteṣv iti | satyadharmasādhvācāraśauceṣu, sarvadā ratiṃ bhāvayet | śāsanīyāṃś ca bhāryādīn “pṛṣṭhatas tu śarīrasya” ityādiśāstramaryādayā vāgbāhūdarasayamayukto niyamayed ity uktam | punarvacana aśiṣṭānām abhiniveśadārḍhyārtham || 4.175 ||

original: parityajed iti | saty api ca trivargasya puruṣārthatvābhidhāne partityajed iti | dharmam apy asukhodarkaṃ lokasaṃkruṣṭam eva ca | dharmaviruddhāv arthakāmau asukhottarakālaṃ cāśaktasya tīvratapaścaraṇādirūpaṃ dharmaṃ lokābhiśāpajanakaṃ ca madhuparkagovadhādirūpaṃ nācaret || 4.176 ||
analyzed: parityajet iti sati api ca trivargasya puruṣa artha tva abhidhāne partityajet iti dharmam api asukha udarkam loka saṃkruṣṭam eva ca dharma viruddhau artha kāmau asukha uttarakālam ca aśaktasya tīvra tapaḥ caraṇa ādi rūpam dharmam loka abhiśāpa janakam ca madhuparka go vadha ādi rūpam na ācaret

original: anumanteti | anyena hanyamānam avalokya sādhv ayaṃ hantā karotīti yo ‘numodate so ‘numantā | viśasitā aṅgavibhāgakaro na hantā (nihantā) vadhakaḥ, krayavikrayī krītvā vikrīṇīte, saṃskartā randhakaḥ upahartā pariveṣṭā khādako bhakṣayitā, ete ghātakā iti | atra ca nihantāraṃ varjayitvā anyeṣām aghātakānāṃ ghātakavacanam aśāstritaprāṇivadhe ‘numodanādīny api na kāryāṇīty evamarthaṃ na tu ghātakatvapratipādanārthaṃ kartavyākartavyapratipādanaparatvād asya śāstrasya ghātakakhādakādīnāṃ pṛthak prāyaścittadarśanāt || 5.51 ||
analyzed: anumantā iti anyena hanyamānam avalokya sādhu ayam hantā karoti iti yaḥ numodate saḥ numantā viśasitā aṅga vibhāga karaḥ na hantā nihantā vadhakaḥ kraya vikrayī krītvā vikrīṇīte saṃskartā randhakaḥ upahartā pariveṣṭā khādakaḥ bhakṣayitā ete ghātakāḥ iti atra ca nihantāram varjayitvā anyeṣām aghātakānām ghātaka vacanam aśāstrita prāṇi vadhe numodana ādīni api na kāryāṇi iti evamartham na tu ghātaka tva pratipādana artham kartavya akartavya

original: daśāham iti | sapiṇḍeṣu preteṣu śavanimittam āśaucaṃ daśāhorātrāṇāṃ brāhmaṇasyopadiśyate | kṣatriyāder vakṣyamāṇatvād asthimañcayanaṃ vā yāvac caturahorātrān āhitāgneḥ saṃcayanaṃ caturthyām iti gṛhye caturthe ‘hani saṃcayanavidhānāt | tryahaṃ caikāhaṃ vā sarvatrāśaucaprakaraṇe ‘hargrahaṇaṃ rātrigrahaṇaṃ cāhorātrapradarśanārtham | vṛttasvādhyāyādyapekṣaś cāyaṃ vikalpas tatrādhyayanāgnihotrau pratigrahādyārtitāratamyāpekṣayaite vikalpāḥ | yathāyogam āśrayaṇīyān anvicchāto ‘nyatamapakṣāśrayaṇam | tathā ca parāśaraḥ.
analyzed: daśa aham iti sapiṇḍeṣu preteṣu śava nimittam āśaucam daśa ahar rātrāṇām brāhmaṇasya upadiśyate kṣatriya ādeḥ vakṣyamāṇa tvāt asthimat cayanam vā yāvat catur ahar rātrān āhitāgneḥ saṃcayanam caturthyām iti gṛhye caturthe hani saṃcayana vidhānāt tri aham ca eka aham vā sarvatra āśauca prakaraṇe har grahaṇam rātri grahaṇam ca ahar rātra pradarśana artham vṛtta svādhyāya ādi apekṣaḥ ca ayam vikalpaḥ tatra adhyayana agnihotrau pratigraha

original: ekāhāc chudyate vipro yo ‘gnivedasamanvitaḥ |

original: tryahāt kevalavedas tu nirguṇo daśabhir dinaiḥ ||

original: iti vṛttādyapekṣayaiva śaucavaicitryam āha | vṛttādyapekṣe ‘pi śaucāśaucasaṃkoce brāhmaṇasya ca svādhyāyānivṛttyartham ityevamādigautamādivākyadarśanād adhyayanādimadhyād yata eva yasyārtis tāvanmātrānuṣṭhānaprayojana eva tasyāśaucasaṃkoco na kāryāntare | yasyaiva ca svādhyāyādyārtis tasyaivāyam āśaucasaṃkōcaḥ | na piṇḍāntarasyāgnihotrārthaṃ snānopasparśanāt tatkālaṃ pitā śucir ity evamādiśaṅkhādivākyadarśanād iti | evaṃ cārtiviṣaye śaucasaṃkoce sthite tadvyatiriktāntareṣūbhayatra daśāhāni kulasyānnaṃ na bhujyeta |
analyzed: iti vṛtta ādi apekṣayā eva śauca vaicitryam āha vṛtta ādi apekṣe śauca āśauca saṃkoce brāhmaṇasya ca svādhyāya anivṛtti artham iti evamādi gautama ādi vākya darśanāt adhyayana ādi madhyāt yatas eva yasya ārtiḥ tāvat mātra anuṣṭhāna prayojane eva tasya āśauca saṃkocaḥ na kārya antare yasya eva ca svādhyāya ādi ārtiḥ tasya eva ayam āśauca saṃkōcaḥ na piṇḍa antarasya agnihotra artham snāna upasparśanāt tad kālam pitā śuciḥ iti evamādi

original: nirasya tv iti | “snānaṃ maithuninaḥ smṛtam” iti mithune snānavidhānān maithunād anyatrābuddhipūrvaṃ retaḥ srāve saty upaspṛśyaiva pumān śuddhyati | tathā ca mūtravad retasa utsarge śaucam ity āpastambo ‘bravīd etac ceha prasaṅgenāha | yatra punar janane bījanimittamātra evābhisaṃbandho na śāstrato yathā parapūrvābhāryāprasave tatra tryaham āśaucam anuvartate | tathā ca viṣṇuḥ: “parapūrvāsu bhāryāsu prasūtāsu trirātram” iti || 5.63 ||
analyzed: nirasya tu iti snānam maithuninaḥ smṛtam iti mithune snāna vidhānāt maithunāt anyatra abuddhi pūrvam retaḥ srāve sati upaspṛśya eva pumān śuddhi ati tathā ca mūtra vat retasaḥ utsarge śaucam iti āpastambaḥ bravīt etat ca iha prasaṅgena āha yatra punar janane bīja nimitta mātraḥ eva abhisaṃbandhaḥ na śāstrataḥ yathā parapūrvā bhāryā prasave tatra tri aham āśaucam anuvartate tathā ca viṣṇuḥ parapūrvāsu bhāryāsu prasūtāsu tri rātram iti

analyzed: ahnā ca ekena iti ekena ahar rātreṇa navabhiḥ ca ahar rātraiḥ evaṃvṛtta vaśāt daśa ahena nirdiṣṭena mūlyena brāhmaṇasya mūlyena brāhmaṇasya snāna alaṃkāra nirharaṇa ādi kāriṇaḥ brāhmaṇaḥ sapiṇḍa samāna udaka vyatiriktāḥ śuddhi anti sneha nirharaṇe sati asapiṇḍam dvijam pretam iti vakṣyati dharma artham punar nirharaṇa māṇānām āśauca abhāvaḥ eva etat vai paramam tapaḥ yat pretam araṇyam nayanti iti śruteḥ

original: tatrādānaṃ karādīnāṃ bhṛtyebhyo dhanavisargaḥ | praiṣo yo duṣṭatyāgo ‘dhikṛtānāṃ kāmacāraniṣedho varṇāśramiṇāṃ svakarmasaṃdehe ‘rthavadanam, prajānāṃ dhanādivipratipattau vyavahārekṣaṇam, parājitānāṃ daṇḍanaṃ pramādaskhalite prāyaścittaṃ śuddhiḥ ity etad aṣṭavidhaṃ karma cintayet | tathā kārpaṭikodāsthitagṛhapativaidehikatāpasa-vyañjanātmakaṃ pañcaparimāṇaṃ cāravargaṃ yathāvac cintayet | tatra ca paramarmavidṛṣṭachātraḥ kārpaṭikaḥ vyañjanas taṃ vṛttyarthaṃ matvā arthamānābhyāṃ svīkṛtya anyat pūrvavat, rahasi rājā brūyāt taṃ ca paśyasi tat tadānīm evam api vaktavyam iti pravrajyārūḍhapatitaudāsthavyañjanas taṃ prajāśaucayuktaṃ vṛttyarthinaṃ jñātvā rahasi rājā taṃ brūyāt | tvaṃ ca sarvānnotpādanayogyāyāṃ bhuñjyantevāsikarma kuru tataś ca bhūmer atmano ‘nyeṣāṃ ca tatprayuktānāṃ pravrajitānāṃ asmadarthavyavahāriṇāṃ yatheṣṭam āhārcchādanādi dehīti brūyāt karṣakakṣīṇavṛttiḥ prajñāśaucopeto gṛhapativyañjanas taṃ pūrvavad uktvā yathoktāyāṃ bhūmau kṛṣiṃ kārayet | śiṣṭaṃ pūrvavat | muṇḍo jaṭilo vā vṛttikāmas tāpasavyañjanaḥ pūrvavad uktvā uktapūrvavad bhūmau vaṇikkarma kārayet | muṇḍo jaṭilo vā vṛttikāmas tāpasavyañjanaḥ pūrvavad rājājñayā nagarasamīpe atibahumuṇḍajaṭilāntara-kapaṭaśiṣṭapaṇopetas tāpasyaṃ kuryāt | māsadvimāsāntaritaṃ prakāśam igudabadarādimuṣṭim aśnīyāt | rahasi tu yatheṣṭam āhāraṃ rājārpitaṃ bhuñjīta | loke cāsyātītānāgatajñaṃ tadantevāsinaḥ khyāpayeyuḥ | tathāyaṃ lokānāṃ lābhapūjācauropadravādi vyādiśet | tad rājyaprayuktāḥ chadmacāriṇaḥ satyābhidhāyitvajananārthaṃ saṃpādayeyuḥ | evaṃ sakalajanopasañjātāsvā(śvā)samayā sarva eva kāryākāryaṃ saṃsiddhivijijñāsavas tam āgatya pṛcchanti | vārtāntarāṇy ārirādhayiṣayā vartayantīty evaṃ pañcavargaṃ tattvataś cintayet | evaṃ pañcavargaṃ prakalpya tatas tenaiva vargadvāreṇa pararājasyātmīyāṃs tāṃś ca mantryādīnām anurāgāparāgau jñātvā tad anucintayet | vakṣyamāṇasya rājamaṇḍalasya pracāraṃ kaḥ sandhyarthīty evamādikaṃ buddhvā tadanuguṇaṃ cintayet || 7.154 ||

original: āsanaṃ caiva yānaṃ ca saṃdhiṃ vigraham eva ceti | ātmābhyudayaparahānyādikaṃ kāryaṃ vīkṣya saṃdhāyāsanaṃ vigṛhya vā yānaṃ dvaidhaṃ vā saṃśrayaṃ vānutiṣṭheta, tatra tadātvāyatikālayoḥ (?) pareṇa saha sāmyāśaṅkāyāṃ saṃdhiṃ krtvāsīta | yadā tu tadāvasāmye ‘py ātmā prakṛtīnāṃ na vicalitatvaṃ paraprakṛtīnāṃ copajāpasahatvaṃ manyeta tadā vigraham āśrityāsīta | yadā punaḥ parasmād abhyutthito bhavati tathā kṛtātmarāṣṭrasaṃdhāno vigṛhya yāyād vigṛhya yānahetvabhāve pārṣṇigrāheṇa saha saṃdhāya yāyāt tathā kāryāpekṣayā ekena saha saṃdhim apareṇa saha vigraham ity evaṃ dvaidhaṃ kuryāt | yadā tu durbalaḥ san balavatākṣiptas tadā tadviśiṣṭabalam anyam āśrayet || 7.161 ||

analyzed: yathā iti yathā mṛgasya viddhasya sataḥ dṛṣṭi naṣṭasya padam vyādhaḥ rudhira srāva bindu darśanena nayati tathā rājā anumāna pramāṇena dharmasya gatim nayet vidvadbhiḥ dharma pradhānaiḥ dvijātibhiḥ yat śāstra a viruddham āsevitam tat deśa kula jātīnām atra rūpam kalpayet vādi vādi āśaya grahaṇāya yatna ādi śayam kuryāt iti evamartham

analyzed: satyam iti vyavahāra karma pravṛttaḥ rājā satyam draṣṭa adraṣṭa hetutayā saṃpaśyet artham ca sāra asāra tvena ātmānam ca sat asat karmaṇā deśam ca samanantaram rāja antaram vihāram kālam ca jīvita saṃbandham atikrānta balam rūpam ca idam vyādhi jarā bhojya prāyam lobha ādinā a skhalana artham saṃpaśyet

analyzed: tat deśa kula jātīnām aviruddham prakalpayet

original: sadbhir iti | etac ca viruddhavyavahāreṣu vādinaṃ gṛhṇīyād iha ca sadbhir ācaritam ity upādānād idaṃ sadācāraviṣayaṃ jātijānapadādy etat punaḥ sadcāravyatiriktadharmaviṣayam || 846 ||

original: adhamaṇārthasiddhyartham uttamarṇena coditaḥ |
analyzed: adhamaṇa artha siddhi artham uttamarṇena coditaḥ

analyzed: dāpayet dhikasya artham adhamarṇāt vibhāvitam

original: evaṃ sakalavyavahārasādhāraṇaparibhāṣātmakam uktvādhunā ṛṇādānādy adhikṛtyāha adhamarṇārthsiddhyartham iti | dāpayed dhanikasyārtham adhamarṇavibhāvitam | adhamarṇena dhanagrāhiṇā gṛhītaṃ tatprāptyarthaṃ dhanasvāminā rājñā jñāpitaḥ san vakṣyamāṇalekhyādinā pratipāditaṃ dhanaṃ dhanasvāmino ‘dhamarṇaṃ dāpayet ity uttaraprapañcasyaivāyaṃ sāmānyanirdeśaḥ || 8.47 ||
analyzed: evam sakala vyavahāra sādhāraṇa paribhāṣā ātmakam uktvā adhunā ṛṇa ādāna ādi adhikṛtya āha adhamarṇa artha siddhi artham iti dāpayet dhanikasya artham adhamarṇa vibhāvitam adhamarṇena dhana grāhiṇā gṛhītam tad prāpti artham dhana svāminā rājñā jñāpitaḥ san vakṣyamāṇa lekhya ādinā pratipāditam dhanam dhana svāminaḥ dhamarṇam dāpayet iti uttara prapañcasya eva ayam sāmānya nirdeśaḥ

original: yair yair upāyair arthe svaṃ prāpnuyād uttamarṇikaḥ |
analyzed: yaiḥ yaiḥ upāyaiḥ arthe svam prāpnuyāt uttamarṇikaḥ

analyzed: taiḥ taiḥ upāyaiḥ saṃgṛhya dāpayet adhamarṇikam

original: yair yair iti | uttamarṇo yair yair upāyaiḥ svadhanaṃ labhate tais tair upāyaiḥ adhamarṇaṃ nigṛhya tam arthaṃ dāpayet || 8.48 ||
analyzed: yaiḥ yaiḥ iti uttamarṇaḥ yaiḥ yaiḥ upāyaiḥ sva dhanam labhate taiḥ taiḥ upāyaiḥ adhamarṇam nigṛhya tam artham dāpayet

original: dharmeṇa vyavahāreṇa chalenācaritena ca |
analyzed: dharmeṇa vyavahāreṇa chalena ācaritena ca

original: prayuktaṃ sādhayed arthaṃ pañcamena balena ca || 8.49 ||
analyzed: prayuktam sādhayet artham pañcamena balena ca

original: kaiḥ punas tair ity ata āha dharmeṇeti | yad adhamarṇasya prayuktaṃ dhanaṃ tad dharmeṇa nītyā vyavahāreṇa vakṣyamāṇena chalenopādhipūrvakaṃ pratidravyagrahaṇenācaritenābhojanādinā balena gṛhāvarodhādinā paṇcamenottamarṇaṃ sādhayet || 8.49 ||
analyzed: kaiḥ punar taiḥ iti atas āha dharmeṇa iti yat adhamarṇasya prayuktam dhanam tat dharmeṇa nītyā vyavahāreṇa vakṣyamāṇena chalena upādhi pūrvakam prati dravya grahaṇena ācaritena abhojana ādinā balena gṛha avarodha ādinā paṇcamena uttamarṇam sādhayet

original: yaḥ svayaṃ sādhayed artham uttamarṇo ‘dhamarṇikāt |
analyzed: yaḥ svayam sādhayet artham uttamarṇaḥ dhamarṇikāt

original: na sa rājñābhiyoktavyaḥ svakaṃ saṃsādhayan dhanam || 8.50 ||
analyzed: na sa rājñā abhiyoktavyaḥ svakam saṃsādhayan dhanam

original: svayaṃ ya iti | uttamarṇo vyavahāram antareṇa dharmādibhir upāyair vā naraiḥ svaṃ rājanirapekṣam adhamarṇāt dhanaṃ sādhayet | sa ātmadhanaṃ sādhayan madanapekṣaṃ bandhanādikṛtavān asīti evaṃ rājā na kṣeptavyaḥ || 8.50 ||
analyzed: svayam yaḥ iti uttamarṇaḥ vyavahāram antareṇa dharma ādibhiḥ upāyaiḥ vā naraiḥ svam rāja nirapekṣam adhamarṇāt dhanam sādhayet saḥ ātma dhanam sādhayan mad anapekṣam bandhana ādi kṛtavān asi iti evam rājā na kṣeptavyaḥ

original: arthe ‘pavyayamānaṃ tu karaṇena vibhāvitam |
analyzed: arthe pavyaya mānam tu karaṇena vibhāvitam

original: dāpayed dhanikasyārthaṃ daṇḍaleśaṃ c śaktitaḥ || 8.51 ||
analyzed: dāpayet dhanikasya artham daṇḍa leśam c śaktitaḥ

original: arthe ‘pavyayamānaṃ tu karaṇena vibhāvayed iti | nāham asmai dhārayiṣyāmīty evaṃ dhane vipratipadyamānam adhamarṇaṃ karaṇenālikhyasākṣipathātmakena pratipāditam uttamarṇasya dhanaṃ dāpayet || 8.51 ||
analyzed: arthe pavyaya mānam tu karaṇena vibhāvayet iti na aham asmai dhārayiṣyāmi iti evam dhane vipratipadyamānam adhamarṇam karaṇena ālikhya sākṣi patha ātmakena pratipāditam uttamarṇasya dhanam dāpayet

original: apahnave ‘dhamarṇasya dehīty uktasya saṃsadi |
analyzed: apahnave dhamarṇasya dehi iti uktasya saṃsadi

original: abhiyokādiśed deśyaṃ kāraṇaṃ vānyad uddiśet || 8.52 ||
analyzed: abhiyokā ādiśet deśyam kāraṇam vā anyat uddiśet

original: apahnava iti | abhiyoktā diśed deśyaṃ karaṇaṃ vānyam uddiśet | adhamarṇasya dehīty uttmarṇasya dhanam ity evaṃ sabhāyāṃ prāḍvivākenoktaś ca na dhārayāmīty evam apalāpe saty ākṣepakrodhagrahaṇadeśaṃ tatratryasākṣyupanyāsādyapahnavatvāt karaṇaṃ śaṃset || 8.52 ||
analyzed: apahnavaḥ iti abhiyoktā diśet deśyam karaṇam vā anyam uddiśet adhama ṛṇasya dehi iti uttma ṛṇasya dhanam iti evam sabhāyām prāḍvivākena uktaḥ ca na dhārayāmi iti evam apalāpe sati ākṣepa krodha grahaṇa deśam tatra tri a sākṣi upanyāsa ādi apahnava tvāt karaṇam śaṃset

original: adeśaṃ yaś ca diśet nirdiśyāpahnute ca yaḥ |
analyzed: adeśam yaḥ ca diśet nirdiśya apahnute ca yaḥ

original: brūhīty uktaś ca na brūyād uktaṃ ca na vibhāvayet |

analyzed: na ca pūrva aparam vidyāt tasmāt arthāt sa hīyate

original: adeśaṃ yaś ca diśati nirdiśyāpahnavīti ceti | apadiśyeti | asaṃbhāṣyeti | brūhīti | abhiyoktā diśed ity uktaṃ tatra yo ‘rthī tathāvidhaṃ deśam apahnavādikaṃ nirdiśati yatra dānagrahaṇe na saṃbhāvyete adhamarṇasya vā tadānīṃ tatrāpasthānaṃ saṃbhavatīti yaś cādeśādikaṃ nirdiśya na tan mayā nirdiṣṭam ity evaṃ paścād apajānīte yo vā pūrvaṃ paścād uktān arthān parasparaviruddhān nāvagacchati yaś cānena mama hastāt suvarṇaṃ gṛhītam ity evaṃ nirdeṣṭavyaṃ nirdiśya etat patreṇa gṛhītam ity evamādinā punar apasarati yo vā pratijñākālopanyastam arthaṃ kasmāt punas tathā rātryādau dānagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam ity evamādirūpeṇa pūrvapakṣavistārakāle prāḍvivākena samyak pṛṣṭaḥ sann antardhatte yaś ca saṃbhāṣaṇānarhe upahārādau deśe sākṣibhiḥ parasparaṃ bhāṣate yaś ca sākṣipraśnaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ no gacchati vā sabhāntaḥ prativādisaṃnihitahaṭhād utplutya gacchati yathāsmin pūrvapakṣe kiṃ brūhīty ukta uttaraṃ na brūyāt yo vā pratijñātaṃ sākṣibhir na vibhāvayet pūrvaṃ vā sākṣigataṃ na jānīyāt svagatasvayaṃ cādharottarāṇi vyaktatvāt sa tasmād vyavahārād dhīyate || 8.53–56 ||
analyzed: adeśam yaḥ ca diśati nirdiśya apahnavīti ca iti apadiśya iti a saṃbhāṣya iti brūhi iti abhiyoktā diśet iti uktam tatra yaḥ rthī tathāvidham deśam apahnava ādikam nirdiśati yatra dāna grahaṇe na saṃbhāvyete adhamarṇasya vā tadānīm tatra apasthānam saṃbhavati iti yaḥ ca adeśa ādikam nirdiśya na tat mayā nirdiṣṭam iti evam paścāt apajānīte yaḥ vā pūrvam paścāt uktān arthān paraspara viruddhān na avagacchati yaḥ ca anena mama hastāt suvarṇam gṛh

original: sākṣiṇaḥ santi mety uktvā diśety ukto diśen na yaḥ |
analyzed: sākṣiṇaḥ santi mā iti uktvā diśa iti uktaḥ diśet na yaḥ

analyzed: dharmasthaḥ kāraṇaiḥ etaiḥ hīnam tam iti nirdiśet

original: sākṣiṇa iti | sākṣiṇo ‘tra mama vidyante ity uktvā brūhi tān ity ukto yasmān na brūyāt taṃ pūrvoktair ebhiḥ parājayakāraṇaiḥ dharmanirṇayapravṛttaḥ prādvivāko jito ‘ym iti kathayet
analyzed: sākṣiṇaḥ iti sākṣiṇaḥ tra mama vidyante iti uktvā brūhi tān iti uktaḥ yasmāt na brūyāt tam pūrva uktaiḥ ebhiḥ parājaya kāraṇaiḥ dharma nirṇaya pravṛttaḥ prādvivākaḥ jitaḥ iti kathayet

analyzed: abhiyoktā na ced brūyāt vadhyaḥ daṇḍyaḥ ca dharmataḥ

analyzed: na ced tri pakṣāt prabrūyāt dharmam prati parājitaḥ

original: abhiyokteti | yo ‘rthī sadya eva pūrvapakṣaṃ na brūyāt tadā dharmavyatikramatāratamyāpekṣayā vadhārho daṇḍanīyaś ca syāt | ākṣiptaḥ punaḥ pakṣatraye yadi na brūyāt tadā dharmaviṣaye parājito ‘nyāyyapravṛttatvenādhārmikatvāt || 8.58 ||
analyzed: abhiyoktā iti yaḥ rthī sadyas eva pūrvapakṣam na brūyāt tadā dharma vyatikrama tāratamya apekṣayā vadha arhaḥ daṇḍanīyaḥ ca syāt ākṣiptaḥ punar pakṣa traye yadi na brūyāt tadā dharma viṣaye parājitaḥ nyāyya pravṛtta tvena adhārmika tvāt

original: ya iti | yaḥ pratyarthī yatparimāṇaṃ dhanam apajānīte yatparimāṇaṃ vā dhanam arthī mithyā kathayati adharmapravṛttau tasmād apahnutān mithyoktāc ca dhanāt dviguṇaṃ daṇḍārthaṃ dāpanīyaḥ | adharmajñāv iti vacanād idam atyantābhiniveśādipravṛttaviṣayam | abhiniveśe tv apahnave taddviguṇam api daśakaṃ śataṃ vakṣyati || 8.59 ||
analyzed: yaḥ iti yaḥ pratyarthī yad parimāṇam dhanam apajānīte yad parimāṇam vā dhanam arthī mithyā kathayati adharma pravṛttau tasmāt apahnutāt mithyā uktāt ca dhanāt dviguṇam daṇḍa artham dāpanīyaḥ adharma jñau iti vacanāt idam atyanta abhiniveśa ādi pravṛtta viṣayam abhiniveśe tu apahnave tad dviguṇam api daśakam śatam vakṣyati

original: pṛṣṭo ‘pavyayamānas tu kṛtāvastho dhanaiṣiṇā |
analyzed: tu kṛta avasthaḥ dhana eṣiṇā

analyzed: tryavaraiḥ sākṣibhiḥ bhāvyaḥ nṛpa brāhmaṇa saṃnidhau

original: pṛṣṭa iti | pratyarthī dhanārthinottamarṇena kṛtarājapuruṣakarṣaṇādiparibhavaḥ prāḍvivākena pṛṣṭo yadāvadhārayāmīty evam apahnavāno bhavati tadā rājādhikṛtabrāhmaṇasamakṣaṃ yady atyantanyūnais tataḥ tribhiḥ sākṣibhiḥ tatra dhanārthinā bhāvanīyaḥ || 8.60 ||
analyzed: pṛṣṭaḥ iti pratyarthī dhana arthinā uttamarṇena kṛta rāja puruṣa karṣaṇa ādi paribhavaḥ prāḍvivākena pṛṣṭaḥ yadā avadhārayāmi iti evam bhavati tadā rāja adhikṛta brāhmaṇa samakṣam yadi atyanta nyūnaiḥ tatas tribhiḥ sākṣibhiḥ tatra dhana arthinā bhāvanīyaḥ

original: yādṛśā dhanibhiḥ kāryā vyavahāreṣu sākṣiṇaḥ |
analyzed: yādṛśāḥ dhanibhiḥ kāryāḥ vyavahāreṣu sākṣiṇaḥ

analyzed: tādṛśān saṃpravakṣyāmi yathā vācyam ṛtam ca taiḥ

original: yā iti | yathāvidhāḥ sākṣiṇa ṛṇādānādivyavahāreṣu uttamarṇādibhiḥ kartavyāḥ tathāvidhān kathayiṣyāmi yathā ca taiḥ satyaṃ kartavyaṃ tam api prakāram abhidhāsyāmi || 8.61 ||
analyzed: yāḥ iti yathāvidhāḥ sākṣiṇaḥ ṛṇa ādāna ādi vyavahāreṣu uttamarṇa ādibhiḥ kartavyāḥ tathāvidhān kathayiṣyāmi yathā ca taiḥ satyam kartavyam tam api prakāram abhidhāsyāmi

original: gṛhiṇaḥ putriṇo maulāḥ kṣatraviṭśūdrayonayaḥ |
analyzed: gṛhiṇaḥ putriṇaḥ maulāḥ kṣatra viś śūdra yonayaḥ

analyzed: arthi uktāḥ sākṣyam arhanti na ye kecid anāpadi

original: gṛhiṇa iti | gṛhasthāḥ putravantaḥ taddeśābhijanāḥ kṣatriyavaiśyaśūdrajātīyā arthinirdiṣṭāḥ santaḥ sākṣitvayogyā bhavanti | te ‘pi gṛhādiparibhavabhayān nānyathā bruvate | nanu ye kecid ṛṇādānād anapakṣe vyavahāre vāgdaṇḍapāruṣyādau punaḥ sākṣepa uktagṛhādivyatiriktā api bhavanti || 8.62 ||
analyzed: gṛhiṇaḥ iti gṛhasthāḥ putravantaḥ tad deśa abhijanāḥ kṣatriya vaiśya śūdra jātīyāḥ arthi nirdiṣṭāḥ santaḥ sākṣi tva yogyāḥ bhavanti te gṛha ādi paribhava bhayāt na anyathā bruvate nanu ye kecid ṛṇa ādānāt anapakṣe vyavahāre vāgdaṇḍa pāruṣya ādau punar sa ākṣepaḥ ukta gṛha ādi vyatiriktāḥ api bhavanti

original: āptāḥ sarveṣu varṇeṣu kāryāḥ kāryeṣu sākṣiṇaḥ |
analyzed: āptāḥ sarveṣu varṇeṣu kāryāḥ kāryeṣu sākṣiṇaḥ

original: nādhyadhīna iti | adhyadhīno garbhadāso ‘tyantaparatvān na kāryaḥ | na vaktavyasarvakarmadoṣād garhaṇīyaḥ yaḥ kutsāditarata eva vacanādidasyur bhṛtakasatyudāsa iti karmāṇīti nairuktāt so ‘pi pāratantryān na kāryaḥ | taskarasya tathābhidhāsyamānatvāt pratiṣiddhakarmakṛdanāsvāsāt na vṛddho ‘tikrāntavyavahārakatvāt |  na śiśuḥ avyavahārakatvāt | eko ‘pi na nāśapravāsāśaṅkayā tasya tryavarair iti niṣedhasiddhau kasyāṃcid avasthāyāṃ dvayor abhyanujñānārthavacanam | antyaś cāṇḍālādiḥ dharmānabhijñatvāt | vikalendriya upalabdhivaikalyāt || 8.66 ||

analyzed: ātmā iti yasmāt śubha aśubha karma pravṛttasya ātmanaḥ ca ātmā eva sākṣī tathā ātmā eva ātmanaḥ śaraṇam tasmāt enam svam ātmānam narāṇām madhyāt uttaram sākṣiṇam asatya abhidhānena kena mama etat dṛṣṭam iti evam buddhim kṛtvā yatas ātmā tava atra sarva sākṣī uttamaḥ sākṣī vidyate ekasya eva ātmanaḥ karma kartavya apadeśaḥ satya nivṛtti arthaḥ

saha khaṭvāsanaṃ caiva sarvaṃ saṃgrahaṇaṃ smṛtam || 8.357 ||
analyzed: saha khaṭvā āsanam ca eva sarvam saṃgrahaṇam smṛtam

original: upakārakriyā kelir iti | saha khaṭvāsanam iti | aṅgānulepanādyupacārakaraṇaṃ krīḍā alaṃkaraṇavāsasāṃ sparśanam | ekakhaṭvāsanaṃ ekayānagamanam ity etat sarvaṃ saṃgrahaṇaṃ manvādibhiḥ smṛtam || 8.357 ||
analyzed: upakāra kriyā keliḥ iti saha khaṭvā āsanam iti aṅga anulepana ādi upacāra karaṇam krīḍā alaṃkaraṇa vāsasām sparśanam eka khaṭvā āsanam eka yāna gamanam iti etat sarvam saṃgrahaṇam manu ādibhiḥ smṛtam

original: striyaṃ spṛśed adeśe yaḥ spṛṣṭo vā marṣayet tayā |
analyzed: striyam spṛśet adeśe yaḥ spṛṣṭaḥ vā marṣayet tayā

original: parasparasyānumate sarvaṃ saṃgrahaṇaṃ smṛtam || 8.358 ||
analyzed: parasparasya anumate sarvam saṃgrahaṇam smṛtam

original: striyam iti | yo ‘deśe stayor aṅge vā nirjane pradeśe vā spṛśet tayā vā apradeśe śroṇyādau nirjane vā deśe spṛṣṭas tūṣṇīm āsīta tasyaitad anyonyasyāṅgīkaraṇe sati saṃgrahaṇaṃ manvādibhiḥ smṛtam | atra yady api saṃgamo na jātaḥ tadā saṃgrahaṇamātre mukhopagamadaṇḍād ūnadaṇḍakalpanā kāryā yato ‘nubandhaṃ parijñāyeti uktam || 8.358 ||
analyzed: striyam iti yaḥ deśe aṅge vā nirjane pradeśe vā spṛśet tayā vā apradeśe śroṇi ādau nirjane vā deśe spṛṣṭaḥ tūṣṇīm āsīta tasya etat anyonyasya aṅgīkaraṇe sati saṃgrahaṇam manu ādibhiḥ smṛtam atra yadi api saṃgamaḥ na jātaḥ tadā saṃgrahaṇa mātre mukha upagama daṇḍāt ūna daṇḍa kalpanā kāryā yatas nubandham parijñāya iti uktam

original: abrāhmaṇaḥ saṃgrahaṇe prāṇāntaṃ daṇḍam arhati |
analyzed: a brāhmaṇaḥ saṃgrahaṇe prāṇa antam daṇḍam arhati

original: caturṇām api varṇānāṃ dārā rakṣyatamāḥ smṛtā || 8.359 ||
analyzed: caturṇām api varṇānām dārāḥ rakṣyatamāḥ smṛtāḥ

original: abrāhmaṇa iti | caturṇām api varṇānāṃ dārā rakṣyatamā smṛtāḥ | daṇḍabhūyastvād abrāhmaṇaśūdro brāhmaṇyām anicchantyāṃ saṃgrahaṇe daṇḍam arhati | caturṇām api varṇānāṃ dhanaputrādīnāṃ madhyād dārā atiśayena rakṣaṇīyāḥ | ata utkṛṣṭasaṃgrahanād api varṇaiḥ bhāryā saṃrakṣaṇīyā || 8.359 ||
analyzed: abrāhmaṇaḥ iti caturṇām api varṇānām dārāḥ rakṣyatamāḥ smṛtāḥ daṇḍa bhūyaḥ tvāt abrāhmaṇa śūdraḥ brāhmaṇyām an icchantyām saṃgrahaṇe daṇḍam arhati caturṇām api varṇānām dhana putra ādīnām madhyāt dārāḥ atiśayena rakṣaṇīyāḥ atas utkṛṣṭa saṃgrahanāt api varṇaiḥ bhāryā saṃrakṣaṇīyā

original: bhikṣukā bandinaś caiva dīkṣitāḥ kāravas tathā |
analyzed: bhikṣukāḥ bandinaḥ ca eva dīkṣitāḥ kāravaḥ tathā

original: saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ saha strībhiḥ kuryur aprativāritāḥ || 8.360 ||
analyzed: saṃbhāṣaṇam saha strībhiḥ kuryuḥ aprativāritāḥ

original: bhikṣukā iti | bhikṣājīvinaḥ stāvakāḥ yajñārthaṃ kṛtadīkṣāḥ sūpakārādayo bhikṣādisvarūpārthaṃ gṛhe strībhiḥ saha saṃbhāṣaṇam anivāritā eva kuryuḥ | teṣāṃ nivāraṇā nāsty eva saṃgrahaṇābhāvāt || 8.360 ||
analyzed: bhikṣukāḥ iti bhikṣā jīvinaḥ stāvakāḥ yajña artham kṛta dīkṣāḥ sūpa kāra ādayaḥ bhikṣā ādi svarūpa artham gṛhe strībhiḥ saha saṃbhāṣaṇam anivāritāḥ eva kuryuḥ teṣām nivāraṇā na asti eva saṃgrahaṇa abhāvāt

original: na saṃbhāṣāṃ saha strībhiḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ samācaret |
analyzed: na saṃbhāṣām saha strībhiḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ samācaret

original: niṣiddho bhāṣamāṇas tu suvarṇaṃ daṇḍam arhati || 8.361 ||
analyzed: niṣiddhaḥ bhāṣamāṇaḥ tu suvarṇam daṇḍam arhati

original: na saṃbhāṣaṃ saha strībhir iti | svāminā niṣiddhaḥ san strībhiḥ sambhāṣaṇaṃ na kuryat | niṣiddhaḥ saṃbhāṣamāṇas tu rājñaḥ suvarṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ dadāti || 8.361 ||
analyzed: na saṃbhāṣam saha strībhiḥ iti svāminā niṣiddhaḥ san strībhiḥ sambhāṣaṇam na kuryat niṣiddhaḥ saṃbhāṣamāṇaḥ tu rājñaḥ suvarṇam daṇḍam dadāti

original: naiṣa cāraṇadāreṣu vidhir nātmopajīviṣu |
analyzed: na eṣa cāraṇa dāreṣu vidhiḥ na ātma upajīviṣu

original: sajjanayanti hi te nārīr nigūḍhāś cārayanti ca || 8.362 ||
analyzed: sat janayanti hi te nārīḥ nigūḍhāḥ cārayanti ca

original: naiṣa iti | “parastriyaṃ yo ‘bhivadet” ityādikaḥ saṃbhāṣaṇaniṣedhavidhiḥ naṭagāyanādidāreṣu veśajīvidāreṣu ca nāsti yataś cāraṇā ātmopajīvinaś ca svabhāryāḥ parapuruṣe saṃśleṣayanti pracchannāś ca bhūtvā naitat kilāsmābhiḥ śatam iti kṛtvā veśakarmaṇi sūcayanty atas taddhāraṇāṃ veśyāprakāratvāt nāsti saṃbhāṣaṇe niṣedhaḥ || 8.362 ||
analyzed: na eṣa iti para striyam yaḥ bhivadet iti ādikaḥ saṃbhāṣaṇa niṣedha vidhiḥ naṭa gāyana ādi dāreṣu veśa jīvi dāreṣu ca nā asti yatas cāraṇāḥ ātma upajīvinaḥ ca sva bhāryāḥ para puruṣe saṃśleṣayanti pracchannāḥ ca bhūtvā na etat kila asmābhiḥ śatam iti kṛtvā veśa karmaṇi sūcayanti atas tad dhāraṇām veśyā prakāra tvāt nā asti saṃbhāṣaṇe niṣedhaḥ

original: kiṃcid eva tu dāpyaḥ syāt saṃbhāṣāṃ tābhir ācaran |
analyzed: kiṃcid eva tu dāpyaḥ syāt saṃbhāṣām tābhiḥ ācaran

original: preṣyāsu caikabhaktāsu rahaḥ pravrajitāsu ca || 8.363 ||
analyzed: preṣyāsu ca ekabhaktāsu rahaḥ pravrajitāsu ca

original: kiṃcid eva tu dāpyaḥ syāt saṃbhāṣāṃ tābhir ācaran | cāraṇa ātmopajīvistrībhiḥ raho ‘prakāśaṃ saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ kurvan kiṃcid eva svalpaṃ daṇḍaṃ dāpanīyaḥ | dāsībhir avaruddhābhir bauddhābhir vratacāriṇībhiś ca saha saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ kurvan kāṃcid daṇḍamātrāṃ dāpyaḥ syāt || 8.363 ||
analyzed: kiṃcid eva tu dāpyaḥ syāt saṃbhāṣām tābhiḥ ācaran cāraṇaḥ ātma upajīvi strībhiḥ raho prakāśam saṃbhāṣaṇam kurvan kiṃcid eva su alpam daṇḍam dāpanīyaḥ dāsībhiḥ avaruddhābhiḥ bauddhābhiḥ vrata cāriṇībhiḥ ca saha saṃbhāṣaṇam kurvan kāṃcid daṇḍa mātrām dāpyaḥ syāt

original: yo ‘kāmāṃ dūṣayet kanyāṃ sa sadyo vadham arhati |
analyzed: yaḥ kāmām dūṣayet kanyām sa sadyas vadham arhati

original: sakāmāṃ dūṣayaṃs tulyo na vadhaṃ prāpnuyān naraḥ || 8.364 ||
analyzed: sa kāmām dūṣayan tulyaḥ na vadham prāpnuyāt naraḥ

original: yo ‘kāmāṃ dūṣayet kanyāṃ sa sadyo vadham arhatīti | yas tulyajātīyo ‘nicchantīṃ kanyāṃ dūṣayati gacchati sa tatkṣaṇād eva brāhmaṇavarjaṃ liṅgacchedādikaṃ vadham arhati | sakāmāṃ dūṣayaṃs tulyo na vadhaṃ prāpnuyāt || 8.364 ||
analyzed: yaḥ kāmām dūṣayet kanyām sa sadyas vadham arhati iti yaḥ tulya jātīyaḥ nicchantīm kanyām dūṣayati gacchati sa tad kṣaṇāt eva brāhmaṇa varjam liṅga cheda ādikam vadham arhati sa kāmām dūṣayan tulyaḥ na vadham prāpnuyāt

original: kanyāṃ bhajantīm utkṛṣṭaṃ na kiṃcid api dāpayet |
analyzed: kanyām bhajantīm utkṛṣṭam na kiṃcid api dāpayet

original: jaghanyaṃ sevamānaṃ tu saṃyatāṃ vāsayed gṛhe || 8.365 ||
analyzed: jaghanyam sevamānam tu saṃyatām vāsayet gṛhe

original: kanyām iti | utkṛṣṭaṃ puruṣaṃ kanyāṃ sevamānāṃ na kiṃcid api daṇḍaṃ rājā dāpayet | hīnajātiṃ punaḥ sevamānāṃ rakṣitā pitṛgṛhe sthāpayet | yāvad anivṛttābhilāṣā syād vṛttihīnajñātisaṃprayogād yāvajjīvaṃ sthāpayet || 8.365 ||
analyzed: kanyām iti utkṛṣṭam puruṣam kanyām sevamānām na kiṃcid api daṇḍam rājā dāpayet hīna jātim punar sevamānām rakṣitā pitṛ gṛhe sthāpayet yāvat anivṛtta abhilāṣā syāt vṛtti hīna jñāti saṃprayogāt yāvajjīvam sthāpayet

original: uttamāṃ sevamānas tu jaghanyo daṇḍam arhati |
analyzed: uttamām sevamānaḥ tu jaghanyaḥ daṇḍam arhati

original: śulkaṃ dāpyaḥ sevamānaḥ samām icchet pitā yadi || 8.366 ||
analyzed: śulkam dāpyaḥ sevamānaḥ samām icchet pitā yadi

original: uttamām iti | śulkaṃ dāpyaḥ sevamānaḥ samām icchet pitā yadi | utkṛṣṭajātīyāṃ kanyām icchantīṃ vā hīnajātir gacchan jātyapekṣayāṅgacchedamāraṇātmakaṃ vadham arhati | samānajātīyā punar icchantīṃ gacchan yadi pitā icchati tadā pituḥ śulkam anurūpam āsuravad dadyān na tu daṇḍyo ‘tha pitā necchati tadā rājñā śulkaparimāṇaṃ dāpyaḥ || 8.366 ||
analyzed: uttamām iti śulkam dāpyaḥ sevamānaḥ samām icchet pitā yadi utkṛṣṭa jātīyām kanyām icchantīm vā hīna jātiḥ gacchan jāti apekṣayā aṅga cheda māraṇa ātmakam vadham arhati samāna jātīyā punar icchantīm gacchan yadi pitā icchati tadā pituḥ śulkam anurūpam āsura vat dadyāt na tu daṇḍyaḥ pitā na icchati tadā rājñā śulka parimāṇam dāpyaḥ

original: abhiṣahya tu yaḥ kanyāṃ kuryād darpeṇa mānavaḥ |
analyzed: abhiṣahya tu yaḥ kanyām kuryāt darpeṇa mānavaḥ

original: tasyāśu kartyā aṅgulyo daṇḍaṃ cārhati ṣaṭśatam || 8.367 ||
analyzed: tasya āśu kartyāḥ aṅgulyaḥ daṇḍam ca arhati ṣaṭśatam 8367

original: abhiṣahyeti | manuṣyaḥ prashya haṭhād ahaṅkāreṇa samānāṃ samānajātīyāṃ tāṃ gamanavarjaṃ aṅguliprakṣepamātreṇaiva nāśayet tasya kṣipram evāṅgulidvayaṃ kartanīyam, daṇḍaṃ ṣaṭśatam asau dāpanīyaḥ || 8.367 ||
analyzed: abhiṣahya iti manuṣyaḥ prashya haṭhāt ahaṅkāreṇa samānām samāna jātīyām tām gamana varjam aṅguli prakṣepa mātreṇa eva nāśayet tasya kṣipram eva aṅguli dvayam kartanīyam daṇḍam ṣaṭśatam asau dāpanīyaḥ

original: sakāmāṃ dūṣayaṃs tulyo nāṅgulicchedam āpnuyāt |
analyzed: sa kāmām dūṣayan tulyaḥ na aṅguli chedam āpnuyāt

original: dviśataṃ tu damaṃ dāpyaḥ prasaṅgavinivṛttaye || 8.368 ||
analyzed: dviśatam tu damam dāpyaḥ prasaṅga vinivṛttaye

original: sakāmām iti | samānajātir icchantīṃ kanyām aṅgulimātraprakṣepeṇa nāśayan aṅgulicchedaṃ na prāpnuyāt kiṃ tu paunaḥpunyena eṣaḥ prasaṅgān nāvarteta tadarthaṃ śatamayaṃ daṇḍaṃ dāpyaḥ || 8.368 ||
analyzed: sa kāmām iti samāna jātiḥ icchantīm kanyām aṅguli mātra prakṣepeṇa nāśayan aṅguli chedam na prāpnuyāt kim tu paunaḥpunyena eṣaḥ prasaṅgāt na āvarteta tad artham śata mayam daṇḍam dāpyaḥ

original: kanyaiva kanyāṃ yā kuryāt tasyāḥ syād dviśato damaḥ |
analyzed: kanyā eva kanyām yā kuryāt tasyāḥ syāt dviśataḥ damaḥ

original: śulkaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ dadyāc chiphāś caivāpnuyāt daśa || 8.369 ||
analyzed: śulkam ca dviguṇam dadyāt śiphāḥ ca eva āpnuyāt daśa

original: kanyeti | śulkaṃ ca triguṇaṃ dadyāt śiphāś caivāpnuyād daśa | yā kanyaiva kanyām aparāṃm aṅguliprakṣepeṇa nāśayet tasyā dviśato daṇḍaḥ syāt | śulkaṃ vāsau kanyāpitur dadyāt |śiphāprahārāṃś ca daśa prāpnuyāt || 8.369 ||
analyzed: kanyā iti śulkam ca triguṇam dadyāt śiphāḥ ca eva āpnuyāt daśa yā kanyā eva kanyām aparām aṅguli prakṣepeṇa nāśayet tasyāḥ dviśataḥ daṇḍaḥ syāt śulkam vā asau kanyā pituḥ dadyāt śiphā prahārān ca daśa prāpnuyāt

original: yā tu kanyāṃ prakuryāt strī sā sadyo mauṇḍyam arhati |
analyzed: yā tu kanyām prakuryāt strī sā sadyas mauṇḍyam arhati

original: aṅgulyor eva vā chedaṃ khareṇodvahanaṃ tathā || 8.370 ||
analyzed: aṅgulyoḥ eva vā chedam khareṇa udvahanam tathā

original: yeti | yā punaḥ strī kanyāṃ nāśayet sā tatkṣaṇād eva śiromuṇḍanasānubandhāpekṣayā aṅgulyor eva chedanam arhati | tathā khareṇa rājamārge vahanam arhati idaṃ cātra pūrvābhyāṃ vikalpitābhyāṃ samanvitam || 8.370 ||
analyzed: yā iti yā punar strī kanyām nāśayet sā tad kṣaṇāt eva śiraḥ muṇḍana sānubandha apekṣayā aṅgulyoḥ eva chedanam arhati tathā khareṇa rājamārge vahanam arhati idam ca atra pūrvābhyām vikalpitābhyām samanvitam

original: bhartāraṃ laṅghayed yā tu strī jñātiguṇadarpitā |
analyzed: bhartāram laṅghayet yā tu strī jñāti guṇa darpitā

original: tāṃ śvabhiḥ kḥadayed rājā saṃsthāne bahusaṃsthite || 8.371 ||
analyzed: tām śvabhiḥ rājā saṃsthāne bahu saṃsthite

original: bhartāram iti | yā strī balavadāḍhyapitrādibāndhavadarpeṇa rūpavaidagdhyād guṇagaṇadarvitā pūrveṇa ca bhartāraṃ puruṣāntarakaraṇenollaṅghayet tāṃ rājā bahujanākīrṇe pradeśe śvabhir bhakṣayet || 8.371 ||
analyzed: bhartāram iti yā strī balavat āḍhya pitṛ ādi bāndhava darpeṇa rūpa vaidagdhyāt guṇa gaṇa darvitā pūrveṇa ca bhartāram puruṣa antara karaṇena ullaṅghayet tām rājā bahu jana ākīrṇe pradeśe śvabhiḥ bhakṣayet

original: pumāṃsaṃ dāhayet pāpaṃ śayane tapta āyase |
analyzed: pumāṃsam dāhayet pāpam śayane tapte āyase

original: abhyādadhyuś ca kāṣṭhāni tatra dahyeta pāpakrt || 8.372 ||
analyzed: abhyādadhyuḥ ca kāṣṭhāni tatra dahyeta pāpa krt

original: taṃ darpitājāraṃ puruṣaṃ dāhayed iti | taṃ pāpakāriṇaṃ puruṣam ayomaye śayane agnijvalite rājā dāhayet | kāṣṭhāni nikṣipeyuḥ yāvad asau pāpakṛd dagdhaḥ syāt || 8.372 ||
analyzed: tam darpita ajāram puruṣam dāhayet iti tam pāpa kāriṇam puruṣam ayaḥ maye śayane agni jvalite rājā dāhayet kāṣṭhāni nikṣipeyuḥ yāvat asau pāpa kṛt dagdhaḥ syāt

original: saṃvatsarābhiśastasya duṣṭasya dviguṇo damaḥ |
analyzed: saṃvatsara abhiśastasya duṣṭasya dviguṇaḥ damaḥ

original: vrātyayā saha saṃvāse cāṇḍālyā tāvad eva tu || 8.373 ||
analyzed: vrātyayā saha saṃvāse cāṇḍālyā tāvat eva tu

original: saṃvatsarābhiśastasyeti | parastrīgamanadoṣeṇa puṃso daṇḍitasya punaḥ saṃvatsare ‘tīte tasyām evābhiśaptasya tasya yathopadeśasya dviguṇo daṇḍaḥ kartavyaḥ daṇḍaḥ kalpate | iha cāṇḍālyā saha nirdeśāt sahasraṃ tv antyajastriyaḥ iti cāṇḍālīgamanatulya eva sa punaḥ saṃvatsare ‘tīte tām eva vrātyāṃ gacchato dviguṇo daṇḍaḥ kāryaḥ || 8.373 ||
analyzed: saṃvatsara abhiśastasya iti para strī gamana doṣeṇa puṃsaḥ daṇḍitasya punar saṃvatsare tīte tasyām eva abhiśaptasya tasya yathā upadeśasya dviguṇaḥ daṇḍaḥ kartavyaḥ daṇḍaḥ kalpate iha cāṇḍālyā saha nirdeśāt sahasram tu antyaja striyaḥ iti cāṇḍālī gamana tulyaḥ eva sa punar saṃvatsare tīte tām eva vrātyām gacchataḥ dviguṇaḥ daṇḍaḥ kāryaḥ

original: śūdro guptam aguptaṃ vā dvaijātaṃ varṇam āvasan |
analyzed: śūdraḥ guptam aguptam vā dvaijātam varṇam āvasan

original: aguptam aṅgasarvasvī guptaṃ sarveṇa hīyate || 8.374 ||
analyzed: aguptam aṅga sarvasvī guptam sarveṇa hīyate

original: śūdra iti | śūdro yadi bhartrā rakṣitām arakṣitāṃ punargacched ā strīrakṣitā gacchan liṅgacchedasarvasvāpahārābhyāṃ yojanīyaḥ | arakṣitāṃ punar gacchan śarīradhanadaṇḍaḥ kartavyaḥ | kāryāvaruddhāpekṣayā daṇḍasya gurulaghubhāvaḥ kalpanīyaḥ || 8.374 ||
analyzed: śūdraḥ iti śūdraḥ yadi bhartrā rakṣitām a rakṣitām punar gacchet ā strī rakṣitā gacchan liṅga cheda sarva sva apahārābhyām yojanīyaḥ arakṣitām punar gacchan śarīra dhana daṇḍaḥ kartavyaḥ kārya avaruddha apekṣayā daṇḍasya guru laghu bhāvaḥ kalpanīyaḥ

original: vaiśyaḥ sarvasvadaṇḍaḥ syāt saṃvatsaranirodhataḥ |
analyzed: vaiśyaḥ sarvasva daṇḍaḥ syāt saṃvatsara nirodhataḥ

original: sahasraṃ kṣatriyo daṇḍyo mauṇḍyaṃ mūtreṇa cārhati || 8. 375 ||

analyzed: śayyā āsanam alaṃkāram kāmam krodham anārjavam

original: drohabhāvaṃ kucaryāṃ ca strībhyo manur akalpayan || 9.17 ||
analyzed: droha bhāvam kucaryām ca strībhyaḥ manuḥ akalpayan

original: śayyāsanam alaṃkāraṃ kāmaṃ krodham anārjavam iti | svāpopaveśanālṅkaraṇamaṇiṃ kāmakrodhalobhāpathātitvakutsitācāratvāni strībhyo manuḥ sargādau kalpitavān | tato āsāṃ rakṣākaraṇe yatnaḥ kāryaḥ || 9.17 ||
analyzed: śayyā āsanam alaṃkāram kāmam krodham anārjavam iti svāpa upaveśana alṅkaraṇa maṇim kāma krodha lobha apatha atitva kutsita ācāra tvāni strībhyaḥ manuḥ sarga ādau kalpitavān āsām rakṣā karaṇe yatnaḥ kāryaḥ

original: nāsti strīṇāṃ kriyā mantrair iti dharme vyavasthitaḥ |
analyzed: na asti strīṇām kriyā mantraiḥ iti dharme vyavasthitaḥ

original: nirindriyā hy amantrāś ca striyo ‘nṛtam iti sthitiḥ || 9.18 ||
analyzed: nirindriyāḥ hi amantrāḥ ca striyaḥ iti sthitiḥ

original: nāsti strīṇāṃ kriyā mantrair iti dharme vyavasthitaḥ iti | mantrair jātakarmādisaṃskārakriyā strīṇāṃ nāstīti śāstramaryādā | evaṃ mantravaj jātakarmādisaṃskārābhāvāt svabhāvataś ca striyo nirvīryā adhyayanābhāvāc cāmantrāś cāmantritve sati dharmajñatvābhāva(vāda?)śauce ‘pi pravarteran | tatparvṛttau ca bhayādyabhāvātvād aśubhāḥ striyaḥiti śāstramaryādā || 9.18 ||
analyzed: na asti strīṇām kriyā mantraiḥ iti dharme vyavasthitaḥ iti mantraiḥ jātakarma ādi saṃskāra kriyā strīṇām na asti iti śāstra maryādā evam mantra vat jātakarma ādi saṃskāra abhāvāt svabhāvataḥ ca striyaḥ nirvīryāḥ adhyayana abhāvāt ca amantrāḥ ca amantri tve sati dharma jña tva abhāva vāda śauce pravarteran ca aśubhāḥ striyaḥ iti śāstra maryādā

original: tathā ca śrutayo bahvyo nigītā nigameṣv api |
analyzed: tathā ca śrutayaḥ bahvyaḥ nigītāḥ nigameṣu api

original: svālakṣaṇyaparīkṣārthaṃ tāsāṃ śṛṇuta niṣkṛtīḥ || 9.19 ||
analyzed: svālakṣaṇya parīkṣā artham tāsām śṛṇuta niṣkṛtīḥ

original: tatheti | niścitam eva vyabhicārātmakatve jñāpikā ‘na caitad vidmo brāhmaṇo(-ṇāḥ) vā” ity evamādyā bahvyāḥ śrutato vedeṣv iti paṭhitāḥ | tāsāṃ ca śrutīnāṃ madhyāt prāyaścittarūpāṃ śrutiṃ śṛṇuta || 9.19 ||
analyzed: tathā iti niścitam eva vyabhicāra ātmaka tve jñāpikā na ca etat vidmaḥ iti evamādyāḥ bahvyāḥ śrutataḥ vedeṣu iti paṭhitāḥ tāsām ca śrutīnām madhyāt prāyaścitta rūpām śrutim śṛṇuta

original: yan me mātā pralulubhe vicaranty apativratā |
analyzed: yat me mātā pralulubhe vicarantī apativratā

original: tan me retaḥ pitā vṛṅktām ity asyaitan nidarśaṇanm || 9.20 ||
analyzed: tat me retaḥ pitā vṛṅktām iti asya etat

original: yan ma iti | mama mātā aptyaparāyaṇā yathānyapuruṣaḥ saṃjātalobhābhūt parapuruṣasaṃkalpaduṣṭaṃ mātṛrajo mama pitā bodhayitvānyasya vyabhicārātmakatvasyaitat liṅgam iti kāraṇāvasthito ‘yam mantro ‘yaṃ ca cāturmāsyeṣṭyaṣṭakāyāṃ ca pādyānumantraṇe viniyuktaprasaṅgān mantraprayojanam āhuḥ || 9. 20 ||
analyzed: yat me iti mama mātā aptya parāyaṇā yathā anya puruṣaḥ para puruṣa saṃkalpa duṣṭam mātṛ rajaḥ mama pitā bodhayitvā anyasya vyabhicāra ātmaka tvasya etat liṅgam iti kāraṇa avasthitaḥ yam mantraḥ yam ca cāturmāsya iṣṭi aṣṭakāyām ca pādya anumantraṇe viniyukta prasaṅgāt mantra prayojanam āhuḥ

original: dhyāyaty aniṣṭaṃ yat kiṃcit pāṇigrāhasya cetasā |
analyzed: dhyāyati aniṣṭam yat kiṃcid pāṇigrāhasya cetasā

original: tasyaiṣa vyabhicārsya nihnavaḥ samyag ucyate || 9.21 ||
analyzed: tasya eṣa nihnavaḥ samyak ucyate

original: dhyāyatīti | bhartur anabhipretaṃ yat kiṃcit puruṣagamanaṃ manasā cintayati tasya manovyabhicārasyānena samyag buddhir ucyate | na vākkāyaviṣayo ‘tas tasyāṃ tadvyabhicārasvabhāvatvād etā yatnato rakṣyā | māteti śravaṇāt putrasyaivedaṃ prāyaścittaṃ na mātuḥ || 9.21 ||
analyzed: dhyāyati iti bhartuḥ anabhipretam yat kiṃcid puruṣa gamanam manasā cintayati tasya manaḥ vyabhicārasya anena samyak buddhiḥ ucyate na tasyām tad vyabhicāra svabhāva tvāt etāḥ yatnataḥ rakṣyāḥ mātā iti śravaṇāt putrasya eva idam prāyaścittam na mātuḥ

original: yādṛgguṇena bhartrā strī saṃpūjyeta yathāvidhi |
analyzed: yādṛgguṇena bhartrā strī saṃpūjyeta yathāvidhi

original: tādṛgguṇā sā bhavati samudreṇeva nimnagā || 9.22 ||
analyzed: tādṛgguṇā sā bhavati samudreṇa iva nimnagā

original: yādṛgguṇeneti | yathārūpeṇa sādhunāsādhunā vā strībhiḥ saha vidhinā saṃyogaṃ (-go?) bhavet tathārūpeṇa tatsaṃparkāt sādhvācārā duḥśīlā vā bhavati | samudreṇa saṃyujyamānā gaṅgāpi tathā svādūdakāpi kṣārodakā saṃpadyata ity ātmasaṃyamākhyāṃ strīrakṣaṇopāyāntaropadeśārtham idam || 9.22 ||
analyzed: yādṛgguṇena iti yathārūpeṇa sādhunā asādhunā vā strībhiḥ saha vidhinā saṃyogam gaḥ bhavet tathārūpeṇa tad saṃparkāt sādhu ācārā duḥśīlā vā bhavati samudreṇa saṃyujyamānā gaṅgā api tathā svādu udakā api kṣāra udakā saṃpadyate iti ātma saṃyama ākhyām strī rakṣaṇa upāya antara upadeśa artham idam

original: etā iti | utkarṣaṃ yoṣitaḥ prāptāḥ svaiḥ svair bhartṛguṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ | etāḥ prakṛtatve darśanārtham anayor matvā etā iti bahuvacanam āhuḥ, api tās tathānyādhamakulādyā nikṛṣṭapatayo nāryaḥ svabhartur asmiṃl loke utkṛṣṭatāṃ prāptāḥ | ato bhāryāsaṃrakṣaṇārthaṃ mayātmasaṃyama āśrayaṇīyaḥ || 9.24 ||
analyzed: etāḥ iti utkarṣam yoṣitaḥ prāptāḥ svaiḥ svaiḥ bhartṛ guṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ etāḥ prakṛta tve darśana artham anayoḥ matvā etāḥ iti bahuvacanam āhuḥ api tāḥ tathā anya adhama kula ādyāḥ nikṛṣṭa patayaḥ nāryaḥ sva bhartuḥ asmin loke utkṛṣṭa tām prāptāḥ atas bhāryā saṃrakṣaṇa artham mayā ātma saṃyamaḥ āśrayaṇīyaḥ

original: eṣoditā lokayātrā nityaṃ strīpuṃsayoḥ śubhā |
analyzed: eṣā uditā lokayātrā nityam strīpuṃsayoḥ śubhā

analyzed: pretya iha ca sukha udarkān prajā dharmān nibodhata

original: eṣa iti | eṣa lokācāraṃ sarvo vaḥ śubho dampatīnirṇaya uktaḥ, idānīṃ sukhahetūn kṛpaṇo paṇyasutajīvinoś cobhayor ity evaṃvidhān prajādharmān śṛṇuta || 9.25 ||
analyzed: eṣaḥ iti eṣa loka ācāram sarvaḥ vaḥ śubhaḥ dampatī nirṇayaḥ uktaḥ idānīm sukha hetūn paṇya suta jīvinoḥ ca ubhayoḥ iti evaṃvidhān prajā dharmān śṛṇuta

analyzed: striyaḥ śriyaḥ ca geheṣu na viśeṣaḥ sti kaścana

original: prajanārtham iti | evam eṣāṃ doṣavaty api śakyapratīkārtavād ataḥ striyo mālyavastrālaṅkaraṇādidānena saṃpādanārhāḥ | etāś ca gṛhaśobhābhūtāḥ striyaḥ śriyaś ca gṛheṣu tulyarūpāḥ niḥśrīkaṃ gṛhaṃ na rājate strīṃ vinā gṛhaṃ ca | evaṃ mahādhanam api prajānimittatvāt strīṇām iyaṃ ślokatraye ‘pi bhūtiḥ || 9.26 ||
analyzed: prajana artham iti evam eṣām doṣavati api śakya pratīka ārtavāt atas striyaḥ mālya vastra alaṅkaraṇa ādi dānena saṃpādana arhāḥ etāḥ ca gṛha śobhā bhūtāḥ striyaḥ śriyaḥ ca gṛheṣu tulya rūpāḥ niḥśrīkam gṛham na rājate strīm vinā gṛham ca evam mahādhanam api prajā nimitta tvāt strīṇām iyam śloka traye bhūtiḥ

original: utpādanam apatyasya jātasya paripālanam |
analyzed: utpādanam apatyasya jātasya paripālanam

original: utpādanam iti | prītyarthaṃ lokayātrāyāḥ pratyahaṃ strī nibandhanam | apatyotpādanaṃ jātasya ca pālanam mitrabandhubhojanādeś ca lokavyavahārasya ekaikaguṇaḥ || 9.27 ||
analyzed: utpādanam iti prīti artham lokayātrāyāḥ pratyaham strī nibandhanam apatya utpādanam jātasya ca pālanam mitra bandhu bhojana ādeḥ ca lokavyavahārasya eka eka guṇaḥ

original: apatyaṃ dharmakāryāṇi śuśrūṣā ratir uttamā |
analyzed: apatyam dharma kāryāṇi śuśrūṣā ratiḥ uttamā

analyzed: dāra adhīnaḥ tathā svargaḥ pitṝṇām ātmanaḥ ca ha

original: apatyam iti | dārādhīnas tathā svargaḥ pitṝṇām ātamaḥ sadā | prajotpādanam agnihotrasādhanaśarīraśuśrūṣāratikrīḍāpitṝṇām ātmanaś cāpatyajananādinā svarga ity etat sadā bhāryāyattam || 9.28 ||
analyzed: apatyam iti dāra adhīnaḥ tathā svargaḥ pitṝṇām ātamaḥ sadā prajā utpādanam agnihotra sādhana śarīra śuśrūṣā rati krīḍā pitṝṇām ātmanaḥ ca apatya janana ādinā svargaḥ iti etat sadā bhāryā āyattam

original: patiṃ yā nābhicarati manovāgdehasaṃyatā |

analyzed: sā bhartṛ lokān āpnoti sadbhiḥ sādhvī iti ca ucyate

original: patim iti | yā manovāgdehasaṃyatā satī manovāgdehaiḥ patiṃ na vyabhicarati sā bhartrārjitān svargalokān prāpnoti sā sādhvīti cocyate || 9.29 ||

analyzed: vyabhicārāt tu bhartuḥ strī loke prāpnoti nidya tām

analyzed: śṛgāla yonim ca āpnoti pāpa rogaiḥ ca pīḍyate

original: vyabhicārād iti | durjanasaṃsargāl loke strī garhyatām, janmāntare śṛgālayoniṃ cāpnoti | antaḥkaraś ca kuṭhārai rogādibhiḥ pīḍyate | mahāprayojanatayā strīṇām utsekotpattyāśaṅkāyāṃ tannivāraṇārtham iha punar uktam || 9.30 ||
analyzed: vyabhicārāt iti durjana saṃsargāt loke strī garhyatām janmāntare śṛgāla yonim ca āpnoti antaḥkaraḥ ca kuṭhāraiḥ roga ādibhiḥ pīḍyate mahā prayojana tayā strīṇām utseka utpatti āśaṅkāyām tad nivāraṇa artham iha punar uktam

original: putraṃ pratyuktaṃ sadbhiḥ pūrvajaiś ca maharṣibhiḥ |
analyzed: putram pratyuktam sadbhiḥ pūrvajaiḥ ca mahā ṛṣibhiḥ

original: viśvajanyam imaṃ puṇyam upanyāsaṃ nibodhata || 9.31 ||
analyzed: viśvajanyam imam puṇyam upanyāsam nibodhata

original: putam iti | punar adhikṛtya śiṣṭair manvādibhiḥ pūrvajātaiś cānyair maharṣibhiḥ saṃvakṣyamāṇaṃ sarvajanahitaṃ kalyāṇakaraṃ paraṃ śṛṇuta || 9.31 ||
analyzed: putam iti punar adhikṛtya śiṣṭaiḥ manu ādibhiḥ pūrva jātaiḥ ca anyaiḥ mahā ṛṣibhiḥ saṃvakṣyamāṇam sarva jana hitam kalyāṇa karam param śṛṇuta

original: bhartuḥ putraṃ vijānanti śrutidvaidhaṃ tu bhartari |
analyzed: bhartuḥ putram vijānanti śruti dvaidham tu bhartari

original: āhur utpādakaṃ kecid apare kṣetriṇaṃ viduḥ || 9.32 ||
analyzed: āhuḥ utpādakam kecid apare kṣetriṇam viduḥ

original: bhartur iti | yo bhartā sākṣād utpāditaputra iti taṃ yo na manyate nātra vipratipattiṃ [-tiḥ], yatra punar udvoḍḥā janayitā tatra dviḥprakārā śrutitaḥ | kecid utpādakam avoḍhāram api tena putreṇa putravantam ātmānam āhuḥ | apare tu kṣetrasvāminaṃ voḍhāram anyajanitenāpi putreṇa putravantam āhuḥ || 9.32 ||
analyzed: bhartuḥ iti yaḥ bhartā sākṣāt utpādita putraḥ iti tam yaḥ na manyate na atra vipratipattim yatra punar udvoḍḍā janayitā tatra dvis prakārā śrutitaḥ kecid utpādakam avoḍhāram api tena putreṇa putravantam ātmānam āhuḥ apare tu kṣetra svāminam voḍhāram anya janitena api putreṇa putravantam āhuḥ

original: kṣetrabhūtā smṛtā nārī bījabhūtaḥ smṛtaḥ pumān |
analyzed: kṣetra bhūtā smṛtā nārī bīja bhūtaḥ smṛtaḥ pumān

original: kṣetrabījasamāyogāt saṃbhavaḥ sarvedehinām || 9.33 ||
analyzed: kṣetra bīja samāyogāt saṃbhavaḥ sarve dehinām

original: kṣetrabhūteti | vrīhyādyutpattisthānatulyā ṛṣibhiḥ smṛtā, manuṣyaś ca vrīhyādibījatulyaḥ smṛto yasmāt kṣetrabījasaṃyogāt sarvaprāṇinām utpattir evaṃ cobhayoḥ kāraṇatvasyātiśiṣṭatvād yuktā vipratipattiḥ – kiṃ yatsaṃbandhi kṣetraṃ tasyāpatyaṃ uta bījinaḥ iti || 9.33 ||
analyzed: kṣetra bhūtā iti vrīhi ādi utpatti sthāna tulyāḥ ṛṣibhiḥ smṛtāḥ manuṣyaḥ ca vrīhi ādi bīja tulyaḥ smṛtaḥ yasmāt kṣetra bīja saṃyogāt sarva prāṇinām utpattiḥ evam ca ubhayoḥ kāraṇa tvasya atiśiṣṭa tvāt yuktā vipratipattiḥ kim yad saṃbandhi kṣetram tasya apatyam uta bījinaḥ iti

original: viśiṣṭaṃ kutracid bījaṃ strīyonis tv eva kutracit |
analyzed: viśiṣṭam kutracid bījam strī yoniḥ tu eva kutracid

original: ubhayaṃ tu samaṃ yatra sā prasūtiḥ praśasyate || 9.34 ||
analyzed: ubhayam tu samam yatra sā prasūtiḥ praśasyate

original: viśīṣṭam iti | kutracid bījaṃ pradhānaṃ yatra “jātā ye tu aniyuktāyām” iti nyāyena śulkopanītā strīkvacit punaḥ kṣetraṃ yatra yat talpajāpramītasyeti nyāyenopanatā yatra punar bījayonyā mātā pitā ca samaṃ janayitārau tad apatyaṃ praśastaṃ bhavati || 9.34 ||
analyzed: iti kutracid bījam pradhānam yatra jātāḥ ye tu a niyuktāyām iti nyāyena śulka upanītā strī kvacid punar kṣetram yatra yat talpajā apramītasya iti nyāyena upanatā yatra punar bīja yonyāḥ mātā pitā ca samam janayitārau tat apatyam praśastam bhavati

original: bījasya caiva yonyāś ca bījam utkṛṣṭam ucyate |
analyzed: bījasya ca eva yonyāḥ ca bījam utkṛṣṭam ucyate

original: sarvabhūtaprasūtir hi bījalakṣaṇalakṣitā || 9.35 ||
analyzed: sarva bhūta prasūtiḥ hi bīja lakṣaṇa lakṣitā

original: tatra prādhānyapakṣe bhāvam āha bījasyeti | bījakṣetrayor madhyāt bījaṃ pradhānam ucyate, yasmāt sarvapadārthānām utpattir bījagatavarṇarūpādicihnenopalakṣitā dṛśyate || 9.35 ||
analyzed: tatra prādhānya pakṣe bhāvam āha bījasya iti bīja kṣetrayoḥ madhyāt bījam pradhānam ucyate yasmāt sarva padārthānām utpattiḥ bīja gata varṇa rūpa ādi cihnena upalakṣitā dṛśyate
